clips.title: The story
paras: In Razorfen Kraul, Aggem Thorncurse bears the title Death's Head Prophet. He calls a boar spirit to his aid when threatened.
Aggem guards part of Razorfen Kraul, where the Death's Head tribe dwells. His shamanic power lets him summon a boar spirit, reflecting the quilboar's reverence for Agamaggan.
